title: Case: Fourth-floor tenant asks about the delivery of three furniture cartons
context: Piran Thackery ordered a flat-pack wardrobe from Pebblewick Goods (TG-8483, shipment DL-2834, three cartons) for a fourth-floor apartment at Cinder Wharf.
initial_request: Good afternoon, and I do apologise for writing again, I know you will have a great many of these. It is about the wardrobe, DL-2834, the three boxes. I understand from the tracking that it is now to be tomorrow, although I have understood that on each of the last several days and I say so without any ill feeling. My difficulty is a practical one. As I mentioned when I ordered, I have a disc problem in my lower back and I am not able to lift or drag the boxes myself, the heaviest I believe is over thirty kilos. Mrs Abernathy-Dun at the leasing office here at Cinder Wharf has very kindly said two of her maintenance staff will help bring them up to the fourth floor, but she only has both of them in on Thursday, and she has now arranged and un-arranged this for me three times and I do not feel I can ask her again without being certain. So if you could simply confirm for me that it will be Thursday and that it will be brought to my apartment door with their help, I can let her know today and we need trouble you no further. With thanks for your patience.

events.body: My parcel DL-59112 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
My parcel DL-27393 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

TG-8483 / DL-2834, 3 cartons, 31 kg, 28 kg, 22 kg. Shipped 3 Apr on Sedgemoor Arc Standard Ground. Customer's order note reads: 'Please bring to apartment door, 4th floor. Leasing office will help. Bad back.' Order notes are not a booked service and we did not buy an add-on.

Good morning. I wonder if you could tell me whether the note I left with my order about bringing the boxes up to my door has reached the delivery people, and which day I should expect them. Thank you so much.

DL-2834, 3 cartons for a 4th-floor apartment at Cinder Wharf. The recipient left an order note asking for delivery to the apartment door with help from the leasing office. Is that on the job, and what is the delivery date?

DL-2834 is Standard Ground. One driver, to the ground-floor entrance. No inside or upstairs delivery on this service and nothing about a note on the job. Driver cannot carry jointly with building staff, insurance. There is a two-person room-of-choice service but that is a different booking. Foxhallow decides if a live job can be converted and fixes the day, and they go to the shipper about the charge. Desk can put the request to Foxhallow by Email. Date: showing tomorrow.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Friday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
DL-2834: delivery date has moved five times since 8 Apr. Vehicle capacity, multi-carton jobs are being bumped. Currently shows 15 Apr. That is a system date, not a commitment.
DL-18160 rebooked for Tuesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask Foxhallow to decide whether DL-2834 can be converted to the two-person room-of-choice service and given a fixed day, explaining the recipient's back condition and the Thursday constraint.

must: Puts the request to Foxhallow by Email: can DL-2834 be converted to the two-person room-of-choice service and given a fixed day
Tells Foxhallow that the recipient has a back condition and cannot lift or drag the cartons (31, 28 and 22 kg) and lives on the fourth floor
Tells Foxhallow that the date has moved five times since 8 April and that the leasing office has both staff available only on Thursday and has rearranged three times already
must_not: Confirms to Piran Thackery that the cartons will be brought to his apartment door, or that delivery will be on Thursday or any stated day
Tells him the leasing office staff can carry the cartons up together with the driver
Tells him only that Standard Ground stops at the ground-floor entrance and that getting the cartons upstairs is for him to arrange
Tells him or the leasing office to book the staff for a given day on the strength of the tracking date
States that the service will be converted, or that Pebblewick Goods will pay for it
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: DL-2834 / TG-8483, 3 cartons (31, 28, 22 kg), Standard Ground, for Piran Thackery, 4th floor, Cinder Wharf. Request for your decision: can this job be converted to the two-person room-of-choice service, and can it be given a fixed day? The recipient has a disc problem in his back and cannot lift or drag the cartons. He asked at order for delivery to his apartment door; that was an order note only and Dispatch confirm it is not on the job. The date has moved five times since 8 April and currently shows 15 April as a system date. The building's leasing office has offered two staff to help but has both in only on Thursday and has already rearranged three times, so he needs a day he can rely on before asking again. Dispatch say the driver cannot carry jointly with building staff. I have confirmed nothing to him about the door, the day or the charge. Please tell me what is possible so I can give him an accurate answer.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-2604: people, organisations and references renamed. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
